mainEntity.name: How long does backsplash tile installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the kitchen size, tile complexity, and wall condition. A simple backsplash can often be completed in a short project window, while custom patterns, demolition, or wall repairs add time.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple backsplash may be done quickly, but custom layouts or prep work take longer. Wall repair, old tile removal, and detailed cuts around outlets can extend the schedule.
